titleEnglish: Man Kunto Maula — Amir Khusro (from Hadith of the Prophet ﷺ)
poet: Amir Khusro (from Hadith of the Prophet ﷺ)

verses.ar:
Man Kunto Maula
Khuwaja Ali-Un Maula
verses.en:
Whoever accepts me as master — venerable Ali is his master
(Words of the Prophet ﷺ at Ghadir Khumm)

verses.ar:
Shah-E-Mardaan
Shair-E-Yazdaan
Qoowwat-E-Parwardigaar
La Fata Illa Ali
La Saif Illa Zulfiqaar
verses.en:
King of the Brave
The Lion of God
The Strength bestowed by the Lord
There is none like Ali
There is no sword like Zulfiqaar

verses.ar:
Dara Dil E Dara Dil E Dar E Dani
Hum Tum Tanana Nana, Tana Nana Ray
Yalali Yalali Yala Yala Ray
verses.en:
Enter the heart, enter the heart, dissolve within
You and I — sing in sweet melody
(Sufi devotional chants of ecstasy)

verses.ar:
Her Qalb Ali, Jism Ali, Jaan Ali Hai
Ik BeSar-O-Samaan Ka Samaan Ali Hai
Imaan Ka Matlaash E Ye Imaan Keh Doon
Iman To Yeh Hai Mera Imaan Ali Hai
verses.en:
In every heart — Ali; every body — Ali; my very life — Ali
Ali is the sole provision of one who has nothing
The seeker of faith — let me say what faith truly is
This is my faith: my faith is Ali

verses.ar:
Haider-E-Um Qalandaram Mastam
Banda-E-Murtaza Ali Hastam
Peshwa-E-Tamaam Rindanam
K Sag-E-Koh-E-Shair-E-Yazdanam
verses.en:
I am of Haider — a saint drowned in devotion
I am a mere servant of Ali the Chosen One
I am foremost among all those intoxicated by devotion
A mere dog at the mountain of Ali — the Lion of God
